requirements.title: GET_COMMAND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: COMMAND and ERRMSG shall be default character scalars, LENGTH and STATUS shall be integer scalars with decimal exponent range at least four, and the listed intents apply.

pending.GET_COMMAND-COMMAND-default-character-sc: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with a default character scalar COMMAND sentinel; mutation changes COMMAND to an array or nondefault kind and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-LENGTH-integer-scalar-range: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with an integer scalar LENGTH sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes LENGTH to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-STATUS-integer-scalar-range: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with an integer scalar STATUS sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes STATUS to logical and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-ERRMSG-default-character-sca: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with a default character scalar ERRMSG prefilled with a nonblank sentinel; mutation changes ERRMSG to an array and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-argument-intents: Source-control plan verifies only conforming definable actuals for OUT and INOUT arguments; invalid actuals remain unnumbered argument-restriction controls with no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: GET_COMMAND assigns command text and significant length
requirements.definition: COMMAND is assigned the invocation command or all blanks, and LENGTH is assigned the significant command length or zero without considering COMMAND truncation, padding, or presence.

pending.GET_COMMAND-command-assigned-entire-comm: Guarded plan calls GET_COMMAND with COMMAND prefilled by nonblank sentinels plus LENGTH and STATUS sentinels; branch STATUS>0 asserts command retrieval failure effects COMMAND all blanks and LENGTH==0, while nonfailure branches avoid exact invocation-command spelling.
pending.GET_COMMAND-length-significant-or-zero: Guarded plan calls GET_COMMAND with LENGTH and STATUS sentinels and COMMAND absent; branch STATUS>0 asserts LENGTH==0, branch STATUS>=0 asserts LENGTH is nonnegative, and exact invocation-command spelling remains out of scope.
pending.GET_COMMAND-length-independent-of-comman: Guarded plan first obtains LENGTH with COMMAND absent, then repeats with a short COMMAND buffer; branch STATUS==0 or STATUS==-1 asserts LENGTH is unchanged by COMMAND truncation or padding, while failure branches assert only LENGTH==0.

requirements.title: GET_COMMAND STATUS distinguishes truncation, failure, and success classes
requirements.definition: STATUS is assigned -1 for a too-short present COMMAND argument, zero for nonfailure cases without truncation, and a positive value for command retrieval failure.

pending.GET_COMMAND-status-nonnegative-without-c: Call GET_COMMAND with STATUS present and COMMAND absent, starting STATUS at -7777; assert the result is greater than or equal to zero, which excludes the truncation branch.
pending.GET_COMMAND-status-minus-one-for-command: Guarded plan first calls GET_COMMAND with COMMAND absent to obtain LENGTH and STATUS; branch STATUS==0 with LENGTH greater than a short COMMAND buffer length makes a second call with that short COMMAND and asserts STATUS==-1, while all other branches make no truncation claim.
pending.GET_COMMAND-status-zero-for-success: Guarded plan calls GET_COMMAND with COMMAND long enough for the observed LENGTH after a successful length probe; branch STATUS==0 asserts only zero status and keeps exact invocation-command spelling out of scope.
